lines.beaver: 와, 오랜만이야! 너 맞아? 못 알아볼 뻔했어.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, long time no see! Is that you? I almost didn't recognize you.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, oraenmaniya! neo maja? mot arabol ppeonhaesseo.
lines.learner: 응, 나야! 머리 염색하고 커트도 했어.
lines.en: Yeah, it's me! I dyed my hair and got a haircut too.
lines.roman: eung, naya! meori yeomsaekago keoteudo haesseo.

lines.beaver: 뒷모습이 딴사람 같아서 그냥 지나칠 뻔했어.
lines.beaver_en: From behind you looked like someone else, so I almost walked past.
lines.beaver_roman: dwinmoseubi ttansaram gataseo geunyang jinachil ppeonhaesseo.
lines.en: Other friends couldn't recognize me from behind either.

lines.beaver_en: You lost some weight too. Did you work out?
lines.learner: 응, 매일 뛰었어. 해 보니까 재미있더라고.
lines.en: Yeah, I ran every day. Once I tried it, it was fun.
lines.roman: eung, maeil ttwieosseo. hae bonikka jaemiitdeorago.

lines.beaver_en: No beard either? You used to grow one.
lines.en: I shave every morning. Clean is better, I found.

lines.beaver_en: Your eyebrows look a bit different too?
lines.en: I trimmed them too. It made me look different.

lines.beaver: 왜 갑자기 이렇게 바꿨어? 무슨 일 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Why did you suddenly change like this? Did something happen?
lines.beaver_roman: wae gapjagi ireoke bakkwosseo? museun il isseo?
lines.learner: 예전 사진을 봤는데 내가 좀 못나 보이더라고.
lines.en: I saw old photos, and I looked kind of ugly.
lines.roman: yejeon sajineul bwanneunde naega jom monna boideorago.

lines.beaver: 에이, 넌 원래 괜찮았어. 지금은 더 멋있다!
lines.beaver_en: Come on, you were fine before. Now you look even cooler!
lines.beaver_roman: ei, neon wollae gwaenchanasseo. jigeumeun deo meositda!
lines.en: Thanks. Changing my appearance made me feel good too.

lines.beaver: 머리 색 진짜 예쁘다. 무슨 색이야?
lines.beaver_en: Your hair color is really pretty. What color is it?
lines.beaver_roman: meori saek jinjja yeppeuda. museun saegiya?
lines.en: It's brown. The hair salon recommended it.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we go to a café and talk more?
lines.learner: 좋아! 근처에 새 카페가 생겼더라고. 가자.
lines.en: Sure! I saw a new café opened nearby. Let's go.
lines.roman: joa! geuncheoe sae kapega saenggyeotdeorago. gaja.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 거기서 사진도 찍자. 새 모습으로!
lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's take photos there too. With your new look!
lines.beaver_roman: joa. geogiseo sajindo jjikja. sae moseubeuro!
lines.learner: 그래! 오늘 사진은 잘 나올 것 같아.
lines.en: Okay! I think today's photos will turn out well.
lines.roman: geurae! oneul sajineun jal naol geot gata.
